title: Usable neutral project starter and safe configuration
objective: Deliver the five authorized starter foundations and environment/secrets support in one reviewable PR.
approved_sources: User authorization 2026-10-21: one final combined PR for all five starter foundations including environment.

acceptance.description: Safe environment contract, redacted executable validation and explicit agent/loader boundaries.
Working local prerequisite doctor, actionable runner onboarding and honest fleet/CI evidence.
Neutral canonical-path export and trusted structural verification without history/foreign active tasks.
Read-only trusted three-way update report preserves project ownership and reports conflicts/removals.
Reproducible native command map and proportionate security/operations templates with source hints.
Positive/negative distribution and trust tests, original schemas/gates/history preserved.
Independent plan/check/Full/triage chain plus actual PR publication and remaining gates recorded.

manual_evidence: Frozen behavior and authority Full reviews, separate triage/Delta if needed
Real exporter/verifier/update/doctor runs with limits explicit
Final PR identity and remote job readback

stop_conditions: Stop affected work on unknown mandatory context or conflicting authority.
Scope or trust expansion requires an independently reviewed updated plan.
At most two Full rounds; confirmed findings triaged before repair.
forbidden_actions: No merge/release/deploy, runner registration, protection/permission change or automatic downstream apply.
No secrets in Git/chat/logs or artifact uploads, hosted fallback or deployment-runner reuse.
No source/legacy validator/schema/catalog/fingerprint weakening or historical fixture/report rewrites.
No candidate-code execution in export verification/update; no self-authorizing manifest mode or autoapply.
